name: Harbor Row Market
description: A dockside market known for morning-catch seafood stalls and a long row of cut-flower growers.

name: Old Town Square Market
description: Millhaven's largest and oldest market, held in the square since 1974. Go early for the cheese counter.

name: North Fields Growers Market
description: A grower-only market surrounded by orchards — most stalls are run by the farmers themselves.

name: Riverside Lane Market
description: An after-work weekday market with a strong lineup of bakers and ready-to-eat vendors.

name: South Commons Market
description: A family-friendly Saturday market with a small playground and a weekly live-music slot.

name: East Mill Farmstand Collective
description: A weekend-long indoor collective of year-round farmstands, handy for market visits in bad weather.
